summary: Chapter 3 dramatizes t7-t9 faithfully: Feuz closes the Aebischer case and Stettler co-signs, Berta collects the burial document and receives a flat confirmation, the strained silent encounter with Rutz continues the rupture from the Pfarrhaus scene, and Stettler files the Aebischer file beside the Vogel file in the Eichenschrank without confessing.
